data.name: Italian Bread Making
data.headline: Ages 4+ • 2 Hours • $42.40/Person
data.description:
#Master the Art of Italian Sourdough: Bake Perfect Loaves at Home with Just Your Kitchen Essentials!

During this class, you'll learn how to make perfect Italian sourdough bread with the same equipment you can find in a regular home kitchen. The class will focus on how to prepare the dough, using yeast to rise your bread, and how to bake with a delicious crust and soft inside!
data.what_is_included: Every Class is about 2 hours. We will provide all the equipment and ingredients for the class, and every person will make two different bread to bring home. Families, friends, and people curious about food are warmly welcome to join us for an authentic Italian experience!
